usage: tiramemsu <db> <command> [args]

  triples [--s t] [--p t] [--o t] | values s key | dependents eid
  path start expr [--mode m] [--max-hops n] [--graph g]... [--time-respecting[=t]]
  bundle eid | import-bundle file|-
  read options: --as-of <t or RFC 3339> | --history | --valid-at <date or date-time>
       tiramemsu version [--verbose] | tiramemsu driver
exit 2
